scenes.summary: Tianshi Lu Xin is a fan of the Endmin. However, he treats you as an Endfield professional and fellow Endmin fan who managed to get a good replica of the Endmin's mask. He asks you to help repair the Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility.

lines.text: Ah! Welcome, my Endfielder pro! I'm Lu Xin, the Tianshi on duty...
Wait...! Your mask! Just look at this quality! The color, coating, and glowing effects! My expert pro, you must be...
...a SUPER FAN of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries! I can't believe I'd meet a fellow fan!
I'm a super fan of the Endmin myself! Check out my Endmin mask! Primed, painted, and finished it myself. Definitely one of a kind!
Ah! Almost forgot about the actual business... Yeah. The Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility. We identified the root cause.
During that huge battle, all Applied Tech facilities underwent emergency shutdown. We tried to start them up again, but the Moulder's Xiranflow Track couldn't auto-reset properly...
We need a true professional to pilot a jet drone, use Liquid Xiranite to guide the Xiranite Sliding Block along, and push the Block into the Block Slot.
Ooops. I'm afraid that might be too much information. Just follow me, my expert Endfielder... I'll show you the entire setup.
Before that Endfield pro arrives, I gotta know how to really operate the Xiranflow Track System...

options: Very neat. So, I heard you got a facility problem.

r: Very neat. So, I heard you got a facility problem.

lines.text: Yeah... Push all the Xiranite Sliding Blocks into the Block Slots, then we'll be able to restart the energy fixer.
A successful reboot will help speed up production plans assigned to the Bureau of Applied Technologies.
The Xiranslabs produced are key to Wuling's fight against the Blight Tide!
Heheh... Once this production plan is met, I'll get my leave and join my Endmin Fan event!
Endfielder pro! Quick! See how Xiranite energy is fixed and shaped into Xiranslabs! You don't see this anywhere!

scenes.summary: After you repaired the Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility, Lu Xin realized that the "Endfielder pro" actually happens to be the actual Endministrator. He feels extremely honored in your presence.

lines.text: Haha! Look at that my Endfielder friend! Perfectly fixed and shaped Xiranslabs. We did it!
The reboot would have taken ages as all of our senior Tianshi are absent. Thankfully we got some serious Endfield tech support.
Well, I actually have a small favor to ask. It's not related to work... But I really got to know how to get that super-realistic Endmin mask you're wearing!
My handcrafted version is indeed unique and romantic in its own way, but I can't say no to premium top-notch cosplay merch...
Your mask is definitely made with super-awesome materials and skills. Any true fan of the Endmin must get their hands on one!
Wha? For real? Wait, is your mask the actual thing? How is that possible?! Wait, my Endfielder pro... Are you... No way, are you THE Endministrator of Endfield Industries?!
BY TALOS! I'm such an idiot... I ... I can't believe I ordered the Endmin around to do my work...
Blighted heavens, I didn't even bring my autograph book with me... Wait. Why would I even need an autograph?! I partnered up with the actual Endmin!
Endmin, you're just as perfect as every legend claims! NO! You're even perfect-er than the legends. Your skills are friggin' uber and you're so friendly too...
That's why you're the Hero of the Civilization Band! Oh... I actually saw the Endmin with my own eyes. I can finally die in peace now!
I gotta tell my Endmin Fan Group about this! They'll be Xiranite-green with envy... This story will carry me to my grave!
No way, the Endmin just praised me in person! Gotta memorize every word and tell everyone in the Fan Group!

options: Mine is not for sale, fam.
Well said. It's straight out of Dijiang, Endmin's choice.
Pleasure repairing stuff with you, fam.
People like you who are the true heroes of Wuling.
